# ASAPP Appoints Katie Stein as CEO to Accelerate AI Transformation of the Contact Center  
## Veteran CX executive brings operational depth as company shifts from product transformation to scaling growth  
**NEW YORK, August 4, 2026** – [ASAPP](https://www.asapp.com/), the [Customer Experience Platform](https://www.asapp.com/cxp) (CXP) powering AI-driven customer service for the agentic enterprise, today appointed Katie Stein as chief executive officer. Stein brings more than two decades of executive leadership spanning strategy, growth and operations, and technology transformation, and will lead ASAPP through its next phase as the company enters its next stage of growth.  
The appointment comes at an important time for the CX market. Nearly [two-thirds](https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/tech-and-ai/our-insights/tech-forward/state-of-ai-trust-in-2026-shifting-to-the-agentic-era) of organizations say security and risk concerns are the biggest obstacles to using agentic AI effectively. As a result, businesses need solutions that provide control and accountability while keeping humans involved when necessary. ASAPP directly fills this need.
## About ASAPP  
ASAPP is the agentic Customer Experience Platform (CXP) purpose-built for enterprise customer service. CXP orchestrates AI agents, human expertise, and enterprise systems to resolve customer issues faster and more accurately across voice and digital channels.
At the core of the platform is GenerativeAgent®, created to autonomously listen, reason, act, and improve through interaction intelligence. Enterprise service teams use ASAPP to run their operations with measurable outcomes, governance, and production-scale reliability.To learn more about ASAPP, visit www.asapp.com.

results.name: Avaya, ASAPP Name New CEOs as CX Leadership Turnover Continues
results.content:
### The Gist  
- **Two announcements, one day apart.Avaya named Jeff Clarke CEO on Aug. 3, and ASAPP named Katie Stein CEO on Aug. 4, putting two contact center and customer experience vendors under new leadership within 24 hours of each other.**
- **Different companies, similar bet.Avaya is leaning on Clarke's turnaround record at legacy tech giants, while ASAPP is leaning on Stein's operating background at Atain and Genpact to scale its agentic AI platform.**
- **Part of a bigger pattern.The moves extend a run of CEO changes across CX and CCaaS vendors that includes NICE, Medallia, Five9, Verint and Qualtrics since the start of 2025.**
- **Industry reaction was swift.Analysts and consultants took to LinkedIn within hours of the Avaya news, drawing comparisons to Clarke's Kodak tenure and debating whether a private-equity operator is the right fit for the moment.**  
Enterprise communications provider Avaya and AI contact center vendor ASAPP each announced new chief executives this week, on consecutive days, adding two more names to a leadership carousel that has spun through much of the customer experience technology sector since 2025.
## ASAPP Taps Katie Stein to Scale Its Platform  
ASAPP, the New York-based AI contact center vendor, on Aug. 4 appointed Katie Stein as chief executive officer. Stein will lead the company as it shifts from product development to scaling its Customer Experience Platform, according to [company officials](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/04/3338350/0/en/asapp-appoints-katie-stein-as-ceo-to-accelerate-ai-transformation-of-the-contact-center.html).  
Stein previously served as CEO of Atain and chief strategy officer at Genpact, where she oversaw enterprise transformation and data analytics. She also held roles at Mercer and Boston Consulting Group, and holds an MBA from Columbia Business School.  
"I strongly believe that AI will not replace human ingenuity, and ASAPP's unique approach in human-in-the-loop (HILA) brings the right human to the right decision point, putting the focus on outcomes through the best use of automation and people," Stein, CEO of ASAPP, said in a statement.

Several of these moves share a common thread: incoming leaders arriving from outside the immediate category, tasked with pushing AI-driven platforms from early adoption into revenue at scale, often against a backdrop of private equity ownership or recent M&A.  
Verint's Rhodes and Medallia's Bishof both stepped up amid post-acquisition integration work; Qualtrics' Maynard arrived weeks after the company closed its $6.75 billion Press Ganey Forsta deal. Avaya's Clarke and ASAPP's Stein fit a related but distinct pattern — both are operators brought in from adjacent industries to professionalize scale-up, rather than internal product leaders promoted from within.

ASAPP has appointed technology and digital transformation veteran Somesh Khanna as chairman of its board of directors, strengthening the governance of the artificial intelligence customer service platform as it expands its enterprise customer ...
ASAPP has appointed technology and digital transformation veteran Somesh Khanna as chairman of its board of directors, strengthening the governance of the artificial intelligence customer service platform as it expands its enterprise customer experience offerings. Khanna, who joined the New York-based company’s board in February 2026, succeeds to the chairman role after several months of advising the company on its growth strategy and the continued development of its AI-powered Customer Experience Platform (CXP).
The appointment of Khanna reflects ASAPP’s focus on expanding enterprise adoption of its AI-powered customer service platform as organizations increasingly invest in automation technologies that integrate with existing customer support workflows rather than replace them. © Copyright 2012 - 2026 | citybiz | Terms of Service | All Rights Reserved
Khanna brings more than three decades of experience leading digital transformation initiatives for global enterprises during his career at McKinsey & Company, where he served as a senior partner before becoming senior partner emeritus. His background spans financial services, enterprise technology and large-scale business transformation, experience that ASAPP expects will support its next phase of commercial growth.
Since joining the board earlier this year, Khanna has worked with the company’s leadership team on enterprise strategy, customer engagement and platform development as ASAPP continues to expand the capabilities of its AI-driven customer service platform.
